description: This file contains functions and rules for propagating 'scale_by' metadata through a computational graph, specifically within the context of PyTorch FX nodes. It includes registration of propagation rules for various tensor operations, and functions to apply these rules during graph analysis.

methods.name: _register_propagate_rule
methods.description: Registers a propagation rule for one or multiple tensor operations.

methods.name: register_propagate_rule
methods.description: Creates a decorator to register a propagation rule for specified tensor operations.

methods.name: propagate_scale_by
methods.description: Main function to propagate 'scale_by' metadata through a sequence of FX nodes with chunking metadata.

methods.name: propagate_div
methods.description: Propagation rule for division operation, propagates 'scale_by' from numerator to output if applicable.

methods.name: propagate_where
methods.description: Propagation rule for 'where' operation, propagates 'scale_by' from true branch to output if false branch is zero.

methods.name: propagate_general_copy
methods.description: Propagation rule for multiple operations where output 'scale_by' is derived from input nodes.

methods.name: propagate_add_sub
methods.description: Propagation rule for addition and subtraction, sets output 'scale_by' if input 'scale_by' are equal.

methods.name: propagate_fma
methods.description: Propagation rule for fused multiply-add operation, propagates 'scale_by' if input 'scale_by' are consistent.
